title: Delaware County Land Bank starts its own demolition grant program
text:

Delaware County Land Bank starts its own demolition grant program
The Delaware County Land Bank launched a new grant program to fund demolition of blighted structures, with applications opening Oct. 1.
The Delaware County Land Bank has announced it is launching its own grant program to fund the demolition of blighted, vacant or abandoned structures located within Delaware County, according to the county.
The Land Bank previously helped administer applications for the Ohio Department of Development's demolition grants program, but this new program is separate from the state's. Applications will be accepted and considered on a rolling, quarterly basis, with decisions made by the Land Bank board within 30 days after a quarter's end. The first application period opens Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026, and closes Thursday, Dec. 31, 2026, the county said.
There is currently no limit to the grant amount being sought, but a minimum 25% local funding match is required. Eligible applicants include municipalities, townships, other local jurisdictions, nonprofit organizations, private property owners or developers, and other entities approved by the Land Bank.
"This is an exciting advancement in our ability to shape growth in Delaware County," said Delaware County Commissioner Jeff Benton, who is a member of the Land Bank board. "With local control and local dollars, we will also be able to respond more quickly to the needs of the community."
The Land Bank, legally known as the Delaware County Land Reutilization Corporation, was established Dec. 28, 2017, thanks to the efforts of late Delaware County Treasurer Jon Peterson, according to the county. It is a public entity guided by appointed representatives from the County Commissioners' Office, the Treasurer's Office, Delaware City and Orange Township.
Residents can learn more and obtain grant application materials by contacting Commissioner Benton at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection), the county said.
Source: Delaware County, https://co.delaware.oh.us/2026/09/23/delaware-county-land-bank-launches-own-demolition-grant-program/
